purpose: Recover the preregistered 90-case statistics and causal mechanism audit from 69 sealed unaffected predecessor cases plus 21 sealed V3R case-level passes, while preserving both aggregate runs as immutable failures.

approval.scope: One immutable read-only V1R audit of the exact failed-but-case-complete V3R source under the user's standing autonomous authorization.
approval.confirmation_reference: User authorized the agent to choose and execute the optimal in-scope route without repeated approvals.

sources.recovery_failure_reason: analysis cannot include a failed case

sampling.raw_effective_counts: 90 finalized case summaries: 30 original M-TARE, 30 defective V9 and 30 layered GT-map diagnostic cases; 30 V9 traces and 30 V9 snapshots.
sampling.source_composition: All nine tunnel_env23 cases and original indices 77 through 89 come from V3R; the other 69 cases come from the predecessor. The predecessor case077 partial is never read.
sampling.selection: No event, block, checkpoint, case or outcome deletion. Probe selection uses only the earliest frame by which both predeclared graph-state mechanisms have appeared, with case ID as the tie breaker.
sampling.split_logic: No training split is involved. C09/C10 and all strict-test assets remain unread.
sampling.spatial_temporal_spacing: Unchanged from the frozen 600-second closed-loop matrix; repeats/checkpoints are not treated as additional independent worlds.

method.main: Verify both failed-run seals; prove all 21 V3R cases independently pass; reconstruct the deterministic 69+21 source map from the frozen 90-case schedule; map only copied case status fields into the frozen analyzer; audit all V9 causal events and select one outcome-blind probe.
method.baseline: Original M-TARE remains the primary randomized-block baseline. Defective V9 is the method under diagnosis; layered GT-map remains diagnostic only.
method.fallback: None. Any state, failure-reason, seal, case, schedule, identity, trace, graph, event or aggregate drift fails the audit.
method.thresholds: No new threshold, checkpoint, parameter or performance-driven selection.

evidence.expected: Two immutable failed-run seals, 21 fully sealed recovery case passes, exact 69+21 provenance, 90-case ten-block statistics, four generator identities, 60 trace/snapshot identities, all mechanism events, outcome-blind probe, RUN_STATE and seal.
evidence.pass: Exactly 90 V2-PASS case summaries enter the unchanged analyzer via an in-memory status-only bridge; all 30 V9 cases pass the causal audit; the V3R aggregate failure is preserved rather than promoted.
evidence.fail: Any non-aggregate recovery failure, any failed recovery case, source drift, forbidden read, mutation, malformed evidence or incomplete design.

estimated_cost.compute: Read-only CPU hashing and JSON analysis; zero ROS, Gazebo, GPU, bag decompression or training.
